the big screen: Many people still prefer watching old classics on the big screen rather than at home.
许多人仍然更喜欢在大银幕上观看老经典电影，而不是在家里看。
all-time: This novel is one of the all-time best sellers in the history of publishing.
这部小说是出版史上空前的畅销书之一。
based: The film is based on a true story that happened in a small town.
这部电影是根据发生在一个小镇上的真实故事改编的。
pass away: Her grandfather passed away peacefully last night at the age of ninety.
她的祖父昨晚安详去世，享年九十岁。
rush hour: You should leave early to avoid the heavy traffic during rush hour.
你应该早点出发，以避开交通高峰期的拥堵。
steal the show: The little girl stole the show with her wonderful performance last night.
昨晚那个小女孩以精彩的表演抢尽了风头。
scriptwriter: The scriptwriter spent two years writing the story for this movie.
这位编剧花了两年时间为这部电影创作故事。
film-maker: The young film-maker hopes to shoot his first documentary next year.
这位年轻的制片人希望明年拍摄他的第一部纪录片。
world-class: The city has built a world-class library that is open to everyone.
这座城市建起了一座面向所有人开放的世界级图书馆。
wrestler: His brother trains every day because he wants to become a professional wrestler.
他哥哥每天坚持训练，因为他想成为一名职业摔跤运动员。
touching: Everyone was moved by the touching story the old man told us.
老人给我们讲的感人故事打动了每一个人。
short story: She wrote a short story about her childhood and sent it to a magazine.
她写了一篇关于自己童年的短篇小说，并寄给了一家杂志社。
take one's time: There is no hurry, so please take your time and think it over.
不用着急，请慢慢来，仔细考虑一下。
have ... to do with: I don't know what his sudden decision has to do with the news.
我不知道他的突然决定和这个消息有什么关系。
show up: He promised to come to the party, but he didn't show up at all.
他答应来参加聚会，但他根本没有露面。
doorbell: Someone is ringing the doorbell; could you go and see who it is?
有人在按门铃，你能去看看是谁吗？
